title: Cards that lift on hover
summary: transition on transform and box-shadow turns an instant hover change into a smooth lift.
explanation: :hover moves the card up 4px and deepens its shadow. Without a transition that change is instant; with one, the browser animates between the two states.
The transition sits on .card, not on .card:hover, so it applies in both directions: the card eases up when you hover and eases back when you leave.
Animating transform rather than top or margin is smoother, because moving with transform never makes the browser recalculate the layout.
tryThis: Hover the cards in the preview.
Move the transition line into .card:hover: it now animates up but snaps back down.
Change 150ms to 600ms and ease-out to linear: slower and more mechanical.
